description: Reads textContent from one or more known DOM elements by canonical id or selector.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the target elements.

id.description: Preferred canonical element ID from DOM.getAXTree.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector for the target element in the main frame.

items.description: DOM query target identified by id, selector, or both.

targets.description: Targets to read, preserving input order in response.data.items.

purpose.description: Describe why this element text is needed, e.g., verifying a success message, reading a result section, or extracting submitted feedback
